compatibility_effect: Adds three draft 2020-12 public JSON contracts: palimnex:retrieval-feedback:v1, palimnex:retrieval-feedback-withdrawal:v1 and palimnex:retrieval-feedback-report:v1. They are closed, bounded, review-attributed, historical-only and explicitly non-authorizing with retrieval_influence false. The report contract includes all five states and an invalid_reason code required to make the shared specification's invalid-record diagnostic observable. Existing public schemas are byte-checked against frozen digests. This lane changes no runtime module, retrieval path, ledger schema, event kind, existing identifier, configuration, command, cache, database or external state.

unresolved_risks: Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema cannot compare sibling numeric properties, so the schemas enforce start_line and end_line minimums while the deterministic test contract checker enforces start_line less than or equal to end_line; runtime payload validation must retain the same cross-field check.

FEEDBACK_SPEC.md requires invalid records to carry a reason code but omits that field from its inline report-record key list; this contract exposes invalid_reason as nullable for valid records and required non-null for invalid records, matching the parallel core implementation and the stated diagnostic requirement.

The full suite, strict mypy, standard gate, fresh reindex, evaluation and ledger-status checks are delegated to the coordinator as required by the lane brief; indexed files changed and must be reindexed and evaluated after integration.
